chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, and Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, all from Al-Hasan ibn Mahboub, from Ali ibn Ri'ab, from Abu Hamza, who said:

I heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) saying: When a man marries a thayyib (previously married) woman who had been married to another husband, and she alleges that he did not come near her since he entered into marriage with her, then the word regarding that is the word of the man, and upon him is to swear by Allah that he has copulated with her, because she is the plaintiff.

He (peace be upon him) said: So if he married her and she was a virgin, and she claims that he did not reach her, then in a situation like this, women know (how to determine), so let her be examined by the one who is reliable from among them. So when she mentions that she is a virgin, then it is upon the Imam to delay him for a year. So if he reached her, or else there would be a separation between the two, and she would be given half the dower, and there would be no waiting period upon her.

key_terms.الثَّيِّب: A woman who has been previously married and consummated her marriage
key_terms.عِدَّة: Waiting period for a woman after divorce or death of husband
key_terms.يَقْرَبْهَا: To come near her (euphemism for sexual intercourse)

ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic legal ruling on proving consummation of marriage when a husband and wife dispute it?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi details the jurisprudential distinction in proving consummation (wusul) between a previously married woman (thayyib) and a virgin (bakr), reflecting the Shia emphasis on evidentiary standards in marital disputes. For a virgin, the procedure involves examination by a trustworthy woman and a one-year waiting period (ajl) to verify virginity, after which the husband pays half the dowry if consummation is not proven. This ruling underscores the practical application of burden of proof in family law, ensuring fairness in financial settlements and marital status determination.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, and Muhammad Bin yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad altogether, from Al Hassan Bin Mahboub, from Ali Bin Raib, from Abu Hamza who said,

‘I heard Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘When the man marries the divorced/widowed woman who had married a husband other than him, so she alleges that he did not come near her since she had copulated beforehand. So the (final) word regarding that would be the word of the man, and upon him is that he swears an oath by Allah<sup>azwj</sup> that he has copulated with her, because she is the plaintiff’.

He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘So if he had married her and she was a virgin, and she claims that he has not arrived to her, so in an situation like this are the good women, so let her be examined by the one who is reliable with it from them. So when she mentions that she is (still) a virgin, so it is upon the Imam<sup>asws</sup> that he respites her for a year. So if he arrives to her, or else there would be a separation between the two, and she would be given half the dower, and there would be no waiting period upon her’.
en.sarwar: 7. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad and Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad all from ibn Mahbub from ibn Ri’ab from abu Hamzah who has said the following: “I once heard abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, saying, ‘If a man marries a woman who was married before to another man and she alleges that the man has not come close to her from the time he entered with her in such case, the words of the man are accepted on oath by Allah that he has gone to bed with her because she is a plaintiff.

5 He (the Imam) has said, ‘If he marries her as a virgin and she alleges that he never approached her, it then is the job of trustworthy women who can examine her and if they say that she is virgin then the Imam gives him one year’s time during which if he is able to reach her, otherwise, they are separated from each other and she is given half of the mahr (dower) and no waiting period is required.’”
